svg.title: One kit state, three views
svg.desc: Left, a gray box: one kit state, agv1 at INSPECTION, Li-Ion, drawn as four slots holding 3.55 V, 3.62 V, 3.70 V and empty. Three arrows lead from it to three gray boxes in the middle, each with one sample line. Tag 1: PDDL facts, sample line (in-slot c1 agv1 s1). Tag 2: JSON record, sample line with "agv": 1. Tag 3: Text, sample line AGV 1 is at the .... An arrow leads from each to a blue box on the right: GP3 planner, GP4 agent and LLM prompt.
